description: This file defines the AuthorizationService interface for authorizing user actions on Hono resources, providing methods to check user permissions for activities and operations on resources within the Hono platform.

classes.name: AuthorizationService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to check if a user is authorized to perform specific activities or operations on resources.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a user is authorized to perform an activity on a resource; returns a Future<Boolean> indicating the authorization result.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a user is authorized to execute an operation on a resource; returns a Future<Boolean> indicating the authorization result.
